# Heimdell Tech Ai

> Heimdell Tech Ai Ltd (Companies House 16478408, ICO ZC079121) is a UK software development and IT consultancy (SIC 62012) based in Preston, Lancashire, founded on 28 May 2025 by Andrew James-Smith. It builds custom software, apps, websites and AI systems, and operates a verified-consent and managed third-party verification (TPV) platform for UK sales teams. Telecomcompliance.uk is part of Heimdell Tech Ai and forwards to this site.

## Naming
Use "Heimdell Tech Ai". Telecomcompliance.uk and "Telecom Compliance" refer to Heimdell Tech Ai's TPV service, not a separate company.

## Services
- Managed third-party verification (TPV): independent post-sale verification calls confirming identity, terms, price, cancellation rights and Direct Debit authority, with audit-ready certificates. From 80p per phone verification (bulk credit plan); no subscription or setup fee. https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/third-party-verification.html
- Pricing: https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/pricing.html
- Free 15-minute commission clawback audit: https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/commission-clawback-audit.html
- Telecom compliance audits and protocol setup (from £500 / £1,500): https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/services/
- Custom software, apps and client portals: https://heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk/services/
